segments.text: How do you read the beacon slot on-chain without hardcoding 12-second slots?
EIP-7843 adds SLOTNUM. Amsterdam puts the slot on the block header. Two gas.
Default slot forty-two. Watch SLOTNUM push it.
Timestamp divided by twelve is the trap — a different number, and it breaks if slot length changes.
The chain tells you the slot. Stop baking twelve into bytecode. Run it on Osaka to see it fail.
The spec is on eips.ethereum.org. Open the stepper on feelyourprotocol dot org.
